# `rep.move`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/rep.move.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`rep.move`: moves representations by a delta, optionally to another page (doc 06 §3.4). Moves never
change connectivity (FR-CON-004).

Every representation's `pos` moves by `delta`; with `page`, its `page` becomes `page`. Routes follow:
for each connection with an endpoint CP drawn by a moved representation (a CP of one of its functions,
the connection on the representation's old page), if both ends are drawn by moved representations
the whole route translates by `delta`; otherwise the route end at the moved endpoint follows
(`geometry::follow_end`: the end vertex moves by `delta`, its neighbour keeps the segment orthogonal).
A cross-page move also moves every connection whose both ends move to the new page; a connection with
only one end on a moved representation (or ending at a junction) is rejected, because the IP-pair
replacement of FR-CON-043 is not in v0. Online numbering renumbers a main representation's device whose
page-based tag collides on the new page (FR-NUM-029). Outcome: none. Coalesce one drag with a key.

## Parameters

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `delta` | [`CmdPt2`](#cmdpt2) | no | `[0,0]` | The displacement; default `[0, 0]`. |
| `page` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) or `null` | no |  | The target page of a cross-page move. |
| `reps` | array of [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The representations, at least one. |

## Types

### CmdPt2

A point or a displacement [x, y] in nanometres, y downwards (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 2 item(s), at most 2 item(s))

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); the lines before it stay committed. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
